hints.title: Asynchronous Invocation Delay
hints.text: Map a collection of deferred routines so that each invocation introduces a fixed duration pause before execution.

hints.title: Promise Delay Chaining
hints.text: Return an array of asynchronous wrapper functions that await a timeout promise before executing the underlying function.

hints.title: Delay Mapper Blueprint
hints.text: Use functions.map(fn => async (...args) => { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); return fn(...args); }).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of functions in array
complexity.notes: Constructs wrapped functions in linear time relative to array length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Executing immediately and delaying resolution blocks concurrency or executes side effects ahead of time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates array of wrapper functions of length N.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of Promise timeout pattern within mapped function closures.
